root_cause: The canonical revenue-learning-store upsert always supplies a new updated_at, even when business evidence is identical. list_due_evidence interprets that timestamp as a material change and re-evaluates previously evaluated records.
prevention: A BEFORE UPDATE trigger retains OLD.updated_at when all business data is unchanged; preserves RETURNING compatibility and advances timestamp for real business changes. Requires protected migration and independent production proof.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until protected merge, migration applied and an independent production readback shows identical evidence upserts keep updated_at. Behavioural PostgreSQL case runs only when REVENUE_EVIDENCE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is set (skipped in CI); verified locally on PostgreSQL 16: identical keeps updated_at, changed advances it, evaluated_at untouched, and two mutations of the trigger are caught.

limitations: Does not eliminate physical update/write-ahead logging
Concurrency, CDC/audit effects and production deploy remain unverified
The race test of the alternative RPC (Evidence Hotfix V5) does not apply to this trigger path
A manual UPDATE of updated_at on an unchanged row is ignored; force re-evaluation through evaluated_at or a changed business column
